content.rendered:
A MOVING ANOINTING

“Then Samuel took a vial of oil, and poured it upon his head, and kissed him, and said, Is it not because the LORD hath anointed thee to be captain over his inheritance?” (1 Samuel 10: 1)

That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.

In Old Testament times, a flask of oil was poured on the head of a would-be king. The oil would ordinarily run down from the head to the face and to garments. It was such pouring of oil that was referred to in Psalm 133, when the oil on Aaron’s head ran down to his skirts. So the oil that was poured on Saul was oil that could run down his skirts; the oil that was poured on Saul made movements.

Friend, the anointing God wants to release on your life is an anointing that would move from your ‘head’ down to your ‘skirts’. It is an anointing that will make impact in different areas of your life; it’s an anointing that will open doors for you with ease; it’s an anointing that will bring great results in your career, business, ministry, academics, etc.

This year, the oil of God upon your life will make movements into various areas of your life. It will move into your future; it will visit your children wherever they are; it will move into the camp of your enemies and turn the tables in your favour; it will locate your clients and turn them in your favour; it will step into your health and roll away every health challenge; it will break the chains of bondage and affliction in your life.

This year, the evidence of God’s anointing upon your life will be manifest in every area of your life; but on the flipside, it is your duty to crave for and ask God for more of His presence and anointing upon your life.

No Exceeding Expansion can be achieved or sustained outside of the power of God at work within you. Ask God for more anointing that will make movements in your life.

Pray With Me: Lord, I receive a Fresh anointing in Jesus’ name!
